scripts.allure:reset: rm -rf allure-results && mkdir -p allure-results && (cp -r allure-report/history allure-results/history 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.test:bc: npm run allure:reset && wdio run tests/config/wdio.bc.conf.js
scripts.test:bc:smoke: npm run allure:reset && wdio run tests/config/wdio.bc.conf.js --spec tests/specs/bc/smoke.spec.js
scripts.report:bc: npm run report:bc:generate && npm run report:bc:open
scripts.report:bc:arquivo: D="relatorios/$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H%M)" && allure generate allure-results --single-file --clean -o "$D" && (cp -r screenshots/bc "$D/evidencias-de-falha" 2>/dev/null || true) && echo "Relatório salvo em $D/index.html"
scripts.test:bc:report: npm run test:bc; npm run report:bc
scripts.test:bc:smoke:report: npm run test:bc:smoke; npm run report:bc
scripts.test:bc:smoke:devices:report: npm run test:bc:smoke:devices; npm run report:bc
scripts.test:bc:devices:report: npm run test:bc:devices; npm run report:bc
scripts.test:bc:devices:parallel:report: npm run test:bc:devices:parallel; npm run report:bc:open
